report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Kavya Reddy | Age: 25
Body Temperature at Scene: 19.8°C | Ambient Temperature: 28.4°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 7.3 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  2. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]
  3. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  4. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]
  5. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Ketamine, GHB, Carbon Monoxide

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
